title: Review function naming
why: Unexpected mixed-case function names make Python APIs less predictable unless an inherited or framework protocol fixes the spelling.
suggestion: Use lower_snake_case for project-owned functions while preserving required external protocol names.
limitations: HTTP handlers, test lifecycle hooks, AST-style visitor hooks, COM methods, monkey-patch replacements, and methods marked override are excluded.
Other dynamically discovered framework callbacks may still require an explicit project lint policy.
